name: jasper-e2e
description: End-to-end tests for the Jasper server

scripts.open: docker compose up --build -d --wait && playwright test --ui; docker compose down -v
scripts.open:sqlite: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.sqlite.yaml up --build -d --wait && playwright test --ui; docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.sqlite.yaml down -v
scripts.ci: docker compose up --build -d --wait && docker compose --profile ci run --rm --build playwright
scripts.ci:sqlite: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.sqlite.yaml up --build -d --wait && docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.sqlite.yaml --profile ci run --rm --build playwright
scripts.down:sqlite: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.sqlite.yaml --profile ci down -v
